comment: Every design/tokens.json token becomes a Pen variable of the same name; pen-tokens.mjs
does that generation, so this file carries only what generation cannot decide.
`authored` is a canvas variable that is not, and will never be, one of tokens.json's
names: a font family, a derived alpha tint pen cannot compute from a color token, or
as-built geometry the library drew for its own historical reference sheets. It exists so
the check can refuse a new canvas variable that is in neither list: silence is how a
variable drifts from tokens.json without either side saying so.
renderedOpacity binds node or descendant-override opacity to generated tokens as numeric
values because variable-bound opacity renders invisible in the installed Pen toolchain.
A node this generator draws itself materializes its own disabled/pending opacity as a
plain number at generation time instead of registering here; this list is for the
hand-authored Component sheets that still carry a variable-bound override.

authored.--font-ui: a registered Pen font-family value, not a token
authored.--font-mono: a registered Pen font-family value, not a token
authored.--color-emphasis-wash: a derived alpha tint; pen has no opacity operator on a color token, so the canvas carries the resolved value under its own name
authored.--asbuilt-outline-indent: as-built reference geometry the library drew for its own historical Component sheets, not a web token
